name: SDG
recent: SD Guthrie 最新季度营收环比增长 9.1% 至 53.93 亿令吉，但净利环比下滑 21.7% 至 7.73 亿令吉。公司宣布与 YTL Power 旗下公司合作，以约 9.3357 亿令吉出售雪兰莪 Klang 的 657 公顷永久土地，并投资最高 1.0112 亿令吉参与 30% 联营开发。同期 ASB 增持至 35%，EPF 与 KWAP 等机构持续申报股权变动。
notable: SD Guthrie 与 YTL Power 旗下公司签署股东协议，拟以约 9.3357 亿令吉出售雪兰莪 Klang 的 657 公顷永久土地，并投资最高 1.0112 亿令吉参与 30% 联营工业开发。
ASB 增持 SD Guthrie 至 35%，收购 1,660 万股。
SD Guthrie 公布 2026 财年第三季度业绩，净利同比下滑 17%。
risks: EPF、KWAP 及 AmanahRaya Trustees 近期多次申报股权变动，显示主要机构股东持仓持续调整。
新闻提及印尼土地纠纷、烟霾及 El Niño 等运营风险。
earnings: 2026 财年第三季度（截至 9 月 30 日）营收为 53.93 亿令吉，环比增长 9.1%，同比增长 4.3%；净利为 7.73 亿令吉，环比下滑 21.7%，但同比增长 44.2%；净利率为 14.3%，低于上一季度的 20.0%。

recent_en: SD Guthrie's latest quarterly revenue rose 9.1% QoQ to MYR 5.393 billion, while net profit fell 21.7% QoQ to MYR 773 million. The company announced a joint venture with a YTL Power subsidiary to dispose of about 657 hectares of freehold land in Klang, Selangor for approximately MYR 933.57 million, and to invest up to MYR 101.12 million for a 30% stake in the development. Meanwhile, ASB raised its stake to 35%, with EPF and KWAP continuing to report shareholding changes.
notable_en: SD Guthrie signed a shareholders' agreement with a YTL Power subsidiary to dispose of about 657 hectares of freehold land in Klang, Selangor for approximately MYR 933.57 million, and to invest up to MYR 101.12 million for a 30% stake in the joint industrial development.
ASB raised its stake in SD Guthrie to 35% after acquiring 16.6 million shares.
SD Guthrie reported third-quarter FY2026 results with a 17% year-on-year decline in net profit.
risks_en: EPF, KWAP and AmanahRaya Trustees have made multiple recent shareholding change filings, indicating ongoing adjustments by major institutional shareholders.
News reports cite operational risks in Indonesia including land disputes, haze and El Niño.
earnings_en: For Q3 FY2026 (ended 30 September), revenue was MYR 5.393 billion, up 9.1% QoQ and 4.3% YoY; net profit was MYR 773 million, down 21.7% QoQ but up 44.2% YoY; net margin was 14.3%, lower than 20.0% in the previous quarter.
